item_short_desc: Rothco’s G.I. Type Dog Tags are the perfect solution for those looking to personalize their tags. Made from durable stainless steel, these blank dog tags are ready for custom imprinting, allowing you to add your own unique touch. Available in a variety of colors, these tags cater to different preferences and styles. Whether you need them for identification, promotional items, or as a personalized gift, these dog tags are versatile and practical. Please note that the chain is not included.
